comment: task-114 (found by cvanderlinden, GitHub issue 2): FUN_0045de80 (a pair goes to the first tee) stamps both golfers with the game clock DAT_00834170, but the decompile typed that global as one byte there, so the start tick became the low byte of the clock sign extended (-128..127). When a golfer finishes hole 1, FUN_00427540 adds (clock - start) / 2 to the hole's time total, about half the course age, so Time to Play grew every year. The original code reads the whole dword (mov eax, dword ptr [0x834170]); the same function compares it with 0x800 the same way. Also three counters in FUN_0040f5c0's course map summary (0x5787cc, 0x561258, 0x5a9cb0) were summed as signed bytes, wrong above 127 (big maps). Written from the original's disassembly, not from any fix by the reporter.
